scope: Synthetic development experiments only; not preregistered and not confirmatory.

protocol_amendments.change: Increase the matched text context limit from 4096 to 8192 tokens for all panel models and, only when an official chat template rejects a system role, preserve the same system text by prepending it to the first user message.
protocol_amendments.trigger: GPT-OSS reached 4097 input tokens on scripted turn 16 and MedGemma's official template raised an alternating-role error on the first turn.
protocol_amendments.handling: Archive the affected runs as pipeline failures and repeat every panel model, including already completed references, under the amended matched regime before scoring.

protocol_amendments.change: Derive a deterministic job-specific localhost API port from SLURM_JOB_ID for baseline and candidate-sweep jobs.
protocol_amendments.trigger: Slurm co-located two single-GPU jobs on one multi-GPU host; the later Muse job encountered Gemma's healthy service on port 8000 and exited before loading Muse.
protocol_amendments.handling: Archive the collision as an orchestration failure, do not invoke the model fallback, and rerun Muse on a unique port.

primary_model_panel.exclusion_rule: A model is reported as a compatibility failure, not silently removed, if its exact registered revision cannot complete the runtime gate on one 80 GB A100.

runtime_gate.reference_repeat_rule: Repeat the six fixed probes twice for any model advanced as an optimization backbone; report exact-match rate and normalized edit similarity.
runtime_gate.failure_handling: Retain logs, exception type, runtime versions, hardware metadata, and the failed model in the denominator. Do not substitute a different revision after viewing performance outputs.

panel_screen.interpretation: The four cases test runtime and optimization plumbing only. Any SPJ generation using them is a pilot and cannot select the paper's systematic candidate.

optimization_extension.patient_surface_mode: AI-authored fixed turn plans for matched candidate comparisons
optimization_extension.repeated_measure_rule: Turns, generation repeats, and alternative simulated-patient surfaces are repeated measures nested within a case blueprint; they do not increase the independent case count.

adaptive_patient_robustness.patient_model_role: Must differ from the evaluated agent backbone and all optimization judges; exact revision, prompt, seeds, and stopping rules must be frozen.
adaptive_patient_robustness.design: Online patient utterances condition on the preceding assistant response while immutable facts and registered goal IDs remain hidden from the agent.
adaptive_patient_robustness.analysis: Paired common seeds with trajectories nested in case blueprint, patient model, and seed; report model-by-agent interaction and do not pool trajectories as independent cases.

post_test_boundary_extension.claim_boundary: This tests whether a pre-test agent fails safely when users present results. It does not extend the intended use to post-test counselling.
post_test_boundary_extension.future_extension_rule: Any post-test intended-use claim requires a separately registered agent version, clinical content review, and evaluation study.

development_selection_rule.pairing: candidate versus frozen baseline with mirrored A/B order
development_selection_rule.minimum_advance_margin: At least 0.05 greater mean mirrored preference points than baseline and no loss on the direct-question endpoint.
development_selection_rule.tie_policy: Retain ties as 0.5; do not force a winner.
